text: Why me?
There are easier ways to commit suicide.
I didn't think it would happen like this.
You dare challenge the Eye?
Dead!
SLAIN!
I don?t believe you defeated me.
growls...
unleashes a barrage of savage attacks!
speaks in a voice like grinding stones, 'Mountain Tegi made of stone will crush this being of flesh and bone!'
goes limp and falls from the air bursting into a cloud of dust upon impact with the ground
dissipates into the air.
May my spirit find peace in the waters.
I have tasted your souls, and I WILL feed on them soon.
laughs and attacks you!
Take one last look at the face of your god!
falls in a pool of black blood.
stops moving.
charges forward.
Curse you!! Da bashers will have yer head.

Welcome to our temple. We are the paladins of the Church of Underfoot. I am lord of our holy order. I call upon you to assist us in the defense of Kaladim. Speak with the master paladins or priests and find ways to prove your allegiance to Brell.
Smoke rises from the fallen grimling's carcass.
You shall be struck down! I must protect the master!
begins to mindlessly pursue you.
moves with incomprehensible speed and fluidity!
Your name shall be added to the most wanted list of the Freeport Militia!!
An Akhevan lifetaker's eyes go black with rage as he glides effortlessly across the broken floor toward you
screeches as it attacks.
releases its grasp on your mind.
The murky ground bubbles as it attacks.
Argggg.' It then coughs violently and falls to the ground, his fur matted with disease and decay.
Just because you have exterminated me does not mean you will progress.
You have battled well and earned entry, however do not think the path is easy from here.
Aaaaagh, not like this!
A valiant effort, but the chilling bosom of decay will overtake you in the end!
Start digging your grave.  The Indigo Brotherhood shall find you.
snaps its bloody fangs at you!
charges at you with terrifying speed!
Guards!  Guards!  Help me!!
You are formidable, perhaps the wrath of Marr will be exercised here!
Death to all!!  None shall get the mallet!!  All shall die!!
groans in agony...
falls to the floor gasping for breath.
croaks.
slowly dissolves back into the earth.
I shall strike you down for the glory of Marr!
drops to the floor no longer filled with life.
My death is with honor.
advances, its gears clanking maddeningly.
Areeeeewwwww
I have been abandoned by my gods, they have failed me.
A brann geistlig's corpse's eyes glow brightly, then fade as it falls to the ground.
You shall have all the Crushbone orc legions on your tail for my death!
The whirlwinds of rocks and debris that were assaulting you stop as Gaukr collapses.
burns brighter as it moves to attack.
May Fennin's flames take you.
makes its way towards you as it prepares to defend this land.
Centurions!!  Legionnaires!!  Come join the fight!
Do not think this is the end, fools. You have only begun to see what will be necessary to preserve this land.
spasms as it goes into the final peace of death.
Natural selection at work.
begins to chant and engage you in combat.
springs in a flash of fur and teeth.
snorts eerily and strikes with alarming speed.
The people of the Plains of Karana will avenge my death!
spines raise as it senses your presence. Excited at the scent of fresh meat, the beast charges forward with deadly intent.
considers the present threat with its piercing eyes.
screams with pleasure as it tears at you.
Your hair stands on end as the corpse emits a bloodcurdling howl.
focuses his chaotic magic as he rushes to attack you!
risked its life to defeat you and failed.
I come to you now, Trushar.
Fer Halas!! One more victory fer the Wolves o' the North!!
screeches eerily before heading in your direction.
springs at you, ready to attack!
dies.. Rodcet Nife is not pleased.
What twisted reasoning would possess you to travel here and challenge the gods themselves? Your madness knows no bounds! The only sensible course of action is to end your miserable existence.
My mantle shall never be passed on. . .
I have no time for this foolishness!  Die quickly, so that I may continue my search.
attempts to swing one final time as its limbs disconnect and tumble to the earth.
cries out, 'Innoruuk, I beseech you! Forgive me this failure!'
stirs suddenly, and stretches out a bony hand to grasp you.
lumbers toward you with a singular purpose.
paws at the soil in anticipation, then charges full-bore directly at you!
Bouncer smash you!!
I'm sorry that it was necessary to kill you, but you left me little choice.
Let this pathetic fool's death be an example of Trushar's will and power.  May the waves of the sea crush your life and wash the world clean of your existence.
glares at you as he falls.
's corpse mumbles a fading, final prayer.
darts forward to attack.
looks surprised at its gaping wounds as it falls.
Let your death be a warning to all who dare oppose the Freeport Militia!
I go to meet my maker! You have done me nothing more than a great service! Ha ha ha!
dies screaming.
You will soon regret disturbing me from my stasis.
's corpse draws a final breath while clawing at its fatal wounds.
's corpse flies apart with a spray of sand.
gives you a slight nod and turns a wistful eye to the sea.
Earless tone-deaf miscreant.  If you cannot differentiate pitch, perhaps you can know the difference between life and death.
is still, but there are always more to take its place.
You seek to challenge me within my own realm? You will know the true meaning of hate!
levels her eyes at you and smiles viciously.
Get da weapons an' smash em dead! Slay em all 'til da ground runs red!
yiyiyi...Vaniki sa mo nis raka ma. aaaah...Vaniki dies, but so do you!
I have friends in very high places!!
Your name shall be added to the Guards of Faydark's most wanted list.
cracks and splinters into massive sheets of ore.
breaks apart into an uneven loamy clod.
Foolish being!! You dare attack a Deepwater knight!!  You shall perish for such audacity!
Rrrrrrrr...

We must continually give praise to the great Prexus for the blessings he has bestowed upon we Othmir!  It is because of our devotion to the Ocean Lord that our shores will never fail to yield a rich harvest of shell fish!
Please run.  I do not wish to hurt you.
Oooh..  I am sorry we had to battle.  I am not like my sisters.  I only wanted to live in peace..
Raise your weapon!!  Let us begin the battle!
May the unholy peace of Innoruuk be with you!!
Hello. The name's  Lars McMannus of Clan McMannus.
Tra la . . . Oh . . . Rats . . .
Ha haa!  Told you!
You are ugly, there is no doubt.  I think I will poke your eyeballs out!
lashes out with its tentacles.
grunts at you and rushes in to attack
Invaders! Kill and crush, claw and tooth! Drive them back!
Sylvan protectors, the glades call for your aid!
The entire Eldritch Collective shall feel the vibrations of my passing.  They will know of your foul deed.
This one has been assaulted, it goes now to eliminate its enemies.
Lord Innoruuk, I have failed you. Forgive me and spare me from service to your undead minions in this world!
shouts loudly as they notice the intruder.
shudders once then lies still.
rustles its leaves as it moves to attack.
Hiss.  SNAP.  SNAP.  Hissssss.
shrieks angrily as it lunges at you!
Fear the Deepwater Knights. My brothers shall avenge me.
is still.  Whatever force animated it is now gone.
You are nothing compared to the dark power of the Brood of Kotiz.
curses you with his dying breath.
clacks menacingly, raising its claws to attack.
For Seru!
There is nothing I will enjoy more than gutting you.
For Bikun!
Arrrgh.
Ware, brothers and sisters of the Eye, one challenges our authority!
Ahh....
Gah. I'd rather be drunk than dead, ya know?  Have ye any spirits?
Rygorr orcs kill in the snow!  We'll bash in your face and cut off your toe!!
What dimwitted Legionnaire passed you through the gates?
You have a lot of nerve, I will give you that.
The Eye shall hear of this!
I wish...
